description: This Dart file defines the Dashboard screen for a Flutter mobile app, including its stateful widget, state management, UI layout, and interactions for displaying financial summaries and a month picker.

classes.name: DashboardScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that builds the main dashboard UI, displaying category summaries and a month picker.

classes.name: _DashboardScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the dashboard's state, including initialization and building the widget tree.

classes.name: _MonthPickerBar
classes.description: A stateless widget rendering the month navigation bar with previous/next buttons and current month display.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state and triggers the loading of dashboard data.
